_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'ashcombe' (The Ashcombe Ruins). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

scholar_orla.name: Orla Coombe
scholar_orla.greeting: Ruins are just history that's fallen over. I help it stand up again, on paper.

digger_tobin.name: Old Tobin the digger
digger_tobin.greeting: I dig. Sometimes I find things. Sometimes things find me.

captain_rosamund.name: Captain Rosamund
captain_rosamund.greeting: The keep is broken. My temper is next.

scav_jory.name: Mudfoot
scav_jory.greeting: Finders keepers. I find, you keep me alive, we split it.

quests.name: The Broken Keep
quests.offer: Millbrook sent you? Good. Scavengers have moved into what's left of my keep and they've better swords than my lads.

steps.where: the courtyard of the Broken Keep

steps.text: Report to Orla Coombe in Ashcombe

quests.done: Orla says there's something under the keep worth seeing. Orla always says that.

quests.name: Bones in the Dust
quests.offer: The barrow hounds dig up my excavation every night. I need those bones in the right order and the hounds in no order at all.
quests.done: Splendid. The skeletons are back where they belong: in my catalogue.

quests.name: Spore Season
quests.offer: Mushroom-things walking about the ruins. Sporecap walkers. They make me sneeze and then they make me run.

steps.where: the damp rooms of the ruins

quests.name: A Duellist's Purse
quests.offer: Two dead men at the duelling stones and one good purse. Moths got there first. Clear 'em off and I'll split the purse. Fair-ish.
quests.done: Here's your half. It's a big half. I'm feeling generous. And watched.

quests.name: Under the Broken Keep
quests.offer: The keep has cellars, the cellars have stairs, the stairs go further down than any keep should. Bring me back a description. And yourself.
quests.done: Marvellous! I shall write a monograph. You'll be a footnote. A large one.

quests.name: The Thing in the Rubble
quests.offer: Something big lives in the rubble field. My lads call it names. Kill it and they'll call you names instead. Nice ones.
quests.done: Good riddance. Drinks at the keep. What's left of it.
